en: The postcard features a color photograph of a modernist high-rise hotel situated near a beach on the Black Sea coast. The building is prominently labeled 'Metropol' on the roof in Cyrillic. It's surrounded by trees, smaller buildings, and a visible pier on the shoreline. The back side contains multiple languages, a typewritten heading referencing the Varna area, Zlatni Pyasatsi (Golden Sands), and the Hotel Metropol.
